newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Autoliv says U.S. tax authority approve merger.
newsitem.headline: Autoliv says U.S. tax authority approve merger.

text.p: Swedish car safety equipment company Autoliv said on Monday the U.S. tax authority gave its preliminary approval to the merger between Autoliv and U.S. Morton's unit Morton Automotive Safety Products.
In addition, the merger has been approved by the necessary competition authorities, Autoliv said in a statement.
"The prospectuses, which are ready to be printed, are expected to be approved by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and the Stockholm Stock Exchange in the next few days," Autoliv said.
